headline: Brookfield to Acquire Indian Container Maker PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.7 Billion
summary: Global asset manager Brookfield agreed to acquire glass packaging manufacturer PGP Glass from Blackstone in a deal valued at $1.7 billion to drive the company's next expansion phase.
why: PGP Glass is an Indian manufacturer supplying specialty glass packaging to international pharmaceutical and cosmetics companies.

impacts.name: PGP Glass
impacts.why: PGP Glass is acquired by Brookfield for $1.7 billion to accelerate regional operations.
